profile.name: Sonu Sharma
profile.title: QA Analyst
profile.headline: I break software before users do, and build test suites that never blink.
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate with ~1.5 years of hands-on experience in web application QA, test automation, and development. Skilled in identifying and reporting defects, performing functional, regression, and UI/UX testing, and collaborating directly with developers in Agile teams. Currently QA Analyst at Sterling Wells Services, driving quality assurance on FigsFlow (AI-native practice & task management system) and its Client Portal. Experienced in test automation using Python, Selenium, Playwright, and Pytest (POM), API testing with Postman, and defect tracking in Microsoft Azure Boards, ClickUp, and Jira.
